cover.headline: Brands will pay you $150-$500 per video, even with zero followers. 7 prompts to land your first UGC deal:

slides.title: prompts to land your first paid UGC deal
slides.sub: No following needed. Just a phone, a plan, and a pitch.
slides.voiceover: Here are seven prompts to land your first paid UGC deal, even with zero followers.

slides.name: The Portfolio Builder
slides.sub: 3 sample videos before anyone pays you.
slides.prompt: Act as a UGC coach. I have no clients yet. Plan 3 sample UGC videos I can film at home with products I already own in [CATEGORY]: the product, the angle, a 30-second script, and the shot list. Make each one show a different **SKILL** brands pay for.
slides.voiceover: One. Plan three sample videos with products you already own, no clients needed.

slides.name: The Brand Finder
slides.sub: Who is actually buying UGC right now.
slides.prompt: Help me find brands that buy UGC in [CATEGORY]. Give me 10 types of brands to target, the signs a brand already pays for UGC (ads, creator posts, hiring pages), where to find their marketing contact, and which **5** to pitch first.
slides.tip: Check the brand's own ad library before you pitch — if they're already running UGC-style ads, they're already paying for this.
slides.voiceover: Two. Find brands already buying UGC, and the five to pitch first.

slides.name: The Script Writer
slides.sub: Ads that sound like a real person.
slides.prompt: Write 3 UGC ad scripts for [PRODUCT] aimed at [AUDIENCE], 20-35 seconds each: a problem-solution, an unboxing, and a 'things I wish I knew' style. Add the first-3-second hook, what to show on screen, and the **CALL TO ACTION** for each.

lines: On screen: hold product to camera

slides.voiceover: Three. Get three ad scripts that sound like a real person, not an ad.

slides.name: The Pitch DM
slides.prompt: Write a short cold email and a DM to [BRAND] offering UGC videos for [PRODUCT]. I'm new but have 3 samples: [LINK]. Keep it under 90 words, lead with an idea for their product, not with me, and end with **ONE CLEAR** question.
slides.tip: Send the DM to the brand's own account and the email to their marketing address — send both, don't pick one.
slides.voiceover: Four. Turn your samples into a short pitch that leads with an idea, not with you.

slides.name: The Rate Card
slides.sub: Price it so you don't work for free.
slides.prompt: Act as a UGC business mentor. Build my rate card as a beginner in [COUNTRY]: price per video, a 3-video bundle, raw footage, usage rights for [30/90] days and whitelisting. Explain each line in one sentence so I can defend it on a call.
slides.voiceover: Five. Build a rate card so you never have to guess a price on a call.

slides.name: The Hook Variations
slides.prompt: I filmed a UGC video for [PRODUCT]. Here is the script: [PASTE SCRIPT]. Write 5 alternative opening hooks I can record in 10 minutes so the brand can test them as separate ads, and tell me which hook fits a **COLD AUDIENCE** best.
slides.tip: Brands pay extra for hook variations because it lets them run more ads from one shoot — mention this when you pitch it.
slides.voiceover: Six. Turn one video into five hooks the brand can test as separate ads.

slides.name: The Repeat Client
slides.sub: Turn one deal into a monthly retainer.
slides.prompt: I delivered my first UGC videos to [BRAND]. Write the delivery message, a short results check-in for 2 weeks later, and a proposal for a monthly package of [NUMBER] videos, with 3 fresh content ideas that make saying **YES** easy.
slides.voiceover: Seven. Turn your first delivery into a proposal for a monthly retainer.

slides.title: Get more out of this pack
items: No brand signs a creator with zero videos to show — the portfolio builder comes before any pitch.
Send the same pitch to all 5 brands from the brand finder the same week — most replies come from volume.
Price it before the call, so you're not making up a number while a brand is waiting on the phone.
slides.voiceover: Film your samples first, pitch five brands at once, and always price it before the call.
